def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

# one task's program: the one shape, cut out by dropping every one-color row and column, mirrored left to right
from lib import compress
def transform(grid):

# another's: every cell as a block whose side is the number of colors other than the background
from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):
    return upscale(grid, len({v for row in grid for v in row}) - 1)

import json,os
P='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpb0-u1-turns/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u048/system/state/workspace/programs'

lib='''def rects(grid):
    """Bounding box (top, left, bottom, right) of each color's cells."""
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row} - {0})
    out = {}
    for c in colors:
        cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v == c]
        rs = [p[0] for p in cells]; cs = [p[1] for p in cells]
        out[c] = (min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs))
    return out

def interior(grid, c):
    """The cells strictly inside color c's bounding box, as a subgrid of raw values."""
    t, l, b, r = rects(grid)[c]
    return [[grid[i][j] for j in range(l + 1, r)] for i in range(t + 1, b)]

def draw_rect(grid, c, t, l, b, r):
    """Draw color c's hollow rectangle outline with corners (t, l) and (b, r) on a copy."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for j in range(l, r + 1): g[t][j] = c; g[b][j] = c
    for i in range(t, b + 1): g[i][l] = c; g[i][r] = c
    return g

def pattern_mask(sub, c):
    """Binary mask of cells equal to c in a subgrid."""
    return [[1 if v == c else 0 for v in row] for row in sub]

def stamp_mask(grid, c, t, l, mask):
    """Set cells of color c where mask is 1, anchored at (t, l), on a copy."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, row in enumerate(mask):
        for j, v in enumerate(row):
            if v: g[t + i][l + j] = c
    return g

def copy_pattern_to_matching(grid):
    """The one rectangle with a filled interior is the source; its interior pattern is stamped (top-left anchored) into every rectangle whose interior exactly matches the pattern size, and every other rectangle is erased."""
    g = [[0] * len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    R = rects(grid)
    P = None; ph = pw = 0
    for c, (t, l, b, r) in R.items():
        sub = interior(grid, c)
        if any(v == c for row in sub for v in row):
            P = pattern_mask(sub, c); ph, pw = len(P), len(P[0])
    for c, (t, l, b, r) in R.items():
        if (b - t - 1, r - l - 1) != (ph, pw): continue
        g = draw_rect(g, c, t, l, b, r)
        g = stamp_mask(g, c, t + 1, l + 1, P)
    return g
'''
